title: Cloud Digital Signage API: Control Your Franchise Screens Without Paying Licenses
body:
Are your branches still displaying expired promotions on their screens?

For a franchise or small retail chain, keeping videos and offers updated across dozens of TVs is a logistical nightmare. You either rely on local employees who forget to plug in the flash drive, or you pay expensive monthly subscriptions for each connected screen, devouring your operating margins and losing control over your own commercial brand.

The trap of Traditional Digital Signage Software

Most solutions on the market force you to buy proprietary hardware or charge you a flat rate for every active monitor, penalizing your B2B growth. Scaling your franchise should not exponentially multiply your IT infrastructure costs.

Our solution: Cloud Content Distribution API

At LANZAESTUDIO, we design a Serverless Cloud Middleware that turns any Smart TV or basic media player into a smart terminal. Your team uploads the video to the central dashboard, and our API distributes it globally in milliseconds.

  1. Real-time global synchronization: Update prices, videos, and banners across hundreds of stores simultaneously with a single click.
  2. Offline-First caching: If a store loses its internet connection, the API ensures the screen continues playing locally stored content without black screens.
  3. Zone-based segmentation: Send specific offers to targeted monitors based on the location or schedule of the branch.
  4. License-free infrastructure: Eliminate per-screen subscriptions by paying only for the actual Cloud bandwidth consumed.

The Real Impact on Your Franchises

  • Drastic savings on SaaS licenses: Convert a fixed monthly expense that slows your expansion into an almost invisible variable cost.
  • Brand consistency guarantee: Ensure all your branches display the right campaign at the exact moment, without human error.
  • Universal hardware deployment: Reuse the TVs you already have installed with no vendor lock-in or complex setups.
